description: This file defines indexing classes and provider logic for the AliasPart in OrchardCore, including the AliasPartIndex class, and the AliasPartIndexProvider class which manages index updates based on content item changes.

classes.name: AliasPartIndex
classes.description: Represents an index record for AliasPart, including ContentItemId, Alias, Latest, and Published flags.

classes.name: AliasPartIndexProvider
classes.description: Provides indexing logic for AliasPart, handling content updates and index mapping.

methods.name: UpdatedAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates the index based on content item changes, removing parts if they are no longer defined in the content type.

methods.name: ForType
methods.description: Returns the type of content items this index provider applies to, which is ContentItem.

methods.name: Describe
methods.description: Defines how content items are mapped to index records, including filtering out soft-deleted items and items without an alias.
